assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring)
The denial cited that precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The service supports the medical necessity of the service billed
